name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 36 - Am 3/2
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 36 a. Urges the Commission to prohibit the allocation of Union funds or participation in Union programmes to public institutions, individuals or associations linked or promoting terrorist, islamist, anti-semitic movements or figures, or any other extremist movement or figures opposed to the fundamental values of the European Union; believes that that restriction should also apply to Union funding of third parties that directly or indirectly contribute to the financing of such entities.
